title: Longest Common Prefix
description:
Find the longest string that is a prefix of every word in a list.

Input format
Line 1: n, the number of words.
Next n lines: one lowercase word per line.

Output format
The longest common prefix, or the text NONE if the words share no common first letter.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 1000. Each word has 1 to 200 lowercase letters.
hints: A prefix common to all words can be no longer than the shortest word.
Compare the words character by character, column by column; stop at the first column where any word differs or ends.
Start with the first word as the candidate prefix and shorten it until every other word starts with it. Remember to print NONE when nothing is left.

examples.explanation: All three start with "fl" but the third letters differ.
There is no shared first letter.
